title: SPRING CHART
summary: Front coil spring and rear transverse leaf spring selection for 1970 coupe and convertible (19437-67), by engine (350 or 454), suspension (standard or F41 special suspension) and sprung curb load per wheel. Gives each spring's rate, design load, GM part number and two-letter spring code, so a restorer can identify the correct spring from its code tag.
notes_internal: Rear table: the RATE PER SIDE cell '70 DWG & 85 CLAMPED', the SPRUNG CURB LOAD cell 'ALL' and the SPRING cell '680 3850839 EA' span both the 350 STD and 454 STD rows; repeated in each row.
'O --> 702' is printed with an arrow; written here as 'O -> 702'.
Spring part numbers (3931823-3931826, 3832518, 3850839, 3828811) appear only in the tables, not in parts, since the page has no callout items.
